name: Valid PAR/code/PKCE/mTLS Authorization Flow
proven_requirements: Valid PAR/code/PKCE/mTLS token issuance with client, audience, lifetime, and certificate binding
preconditions: Registered FAPI client, active Keycloak realm, valid client assertion
action: Execute Pushed Authorization Request (PAR) with RFC 9396 authorization_details, exchange authorization code with PKCE and mTLS client certificate

name: Holder Reduced Account Consent
production_boundary: Keycloak AS token endpoint (:8443) & Resource Server (:4000)
proven_requirements: Token projection and Resource Server enforcement correctly restrict data access to approved accounts without exceeding granted authority
uncovered_aspects: Consent reduction fixture is established via test-assisted endpoint (/api/conformance/holder-consent) rather than interactive end-user browser consent UI The resource server is called over plain HTTP on its application port with the bound client certificate forwarded in the ssl-client-cert header, the way the bank gateway forwards it. This case therefore does not exercise the TLS transport itself; B0-N01-WrongCert covers the certificate binding over real mTLS.
preconditions: TPP requests both holder-approved accounts ACC-001 and ACC-002; the run includes an unreduced positive control
action: Holder restricts consent to ACC-001 while the TPP requests ACC-001 and ACC-002
